Americo Financial Life and Annuity Insurance Company 
MS08I Individual Medicare Supplement - Standard Plans 2010 
SERFF Tracking #: IASL-132741063 
Texas Objection Dated 4/1/2020 
 
 
Dear Kevin Lopez, 
Thank you for your continued attention to our rate filing.   
 
Objection 1 
We will approve up to a 10% rate increase for plan A (aged), a 14% rate increase for plan A (disabled), a 9.3% rate 
increase for plan F, a 10.1% rate increase for plan G, and an 8.1% rate increase for plan N. Please revise the rate sheets. 
Also, update the Percent Rate Change Request and any applicable Company Rate Information on the Rate/Rule 
Schedule tab. 
Response: The Company is willing to amend the Plan A increases as offered by the state. 
 
It is our understanding that the Department calculates approvable amounts by taking a weighted average of the amounts 
already approved and trend for states which are pending. However, the Company anticipates receiving the full amount of 
requested increase in pending states, based on the states that have already approved. Plan F is currently approved at 
100.7% of requested, Plan G is currently approved at 98.7% of requested, and Plan N is currently approved at 95.3% of 
requested.  
 
Instead of weighting pending states by trend, pending states have been weighted using the average of the expected 
increases in pending states weighted by annualized premium. Based on this, the Company proposes a more moderate 
adjustment to the requested rate increase amounts, as shown below. By this calculation, Plan F actually justifies a little 
more than 12.0%; however, the Company would like to keep that proposed increase at 12.0%. Please see the updated 
Exhibit 5 for this calculation. Updated actuarial materials are included with this response. 
 
 
Plan A Plan F Plan G Plan N 
10%/14%  
(as offered) 
12.0%  
(as proposed) 11.3% 8.8%
